species.name: Emberkin

traits.name: Ember Blood
traits.text: You have Resistance to Fire damage.

traits.name: Kindled Step
traits.text: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

traits.name: Forge Sense
traits.text: You have proficiency in the Perception skill and with one of Smith's Tools or Glassblower's Tools.

lineages.name: Cinder
lineages.text: You know the Fire Bolt cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you select this lineage).

lineages.name: Hearth
lineages.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

species.text: Emberkin carry a spark of the forge in their blood. Their skin is warm to the touch, and their eyes glow like banked coals in the dark.

species.name: Mossfolk

traits.name: Rooted
traits.text: You have Resistance to Poison damage.

traits.name: Bloom
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, you sense through the earth: you gain Tremorsense with a range of 30 feet for 10 minutes. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

species.text: Mossfolk grow from the damp roots of old forests and walk where the moss leads them.
